title: Discover David Choe's Sketching Techniques
summary: A sparse 1:08 official-channel excerpt with only two substantive caption units. The caption phrase “after I finish the sketch” conflicts with that sequence and remains semantically unresolved rather than silently rewritten as fact. The rest is laughter, an isolated “so,” a likely automatic-caption “foreign” marker and a clipped final “you.” The title overstates the available evidence: this is one reverse-order process observation, not a developed tutorial. No missing technique, material, sequence or speaker is invented; zero named turns ship.
